name: Breaker double-point status decoding
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
summary: Interprets the two independent auxiliary indications as open, closed or an invalid combination.
description: Interprets the two independent auxiliary indications as open, closed or an invalid combination. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “52a and 52b states” at the input and “Decoded breaker position” at the output. Disagreement must remain distinguishable from transition.

Keep contact reference conditions, terminal numbers and interpretation logic together. Distinguish a mechanically operated indication from a measured current or voltage condition. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application.
